format_note: Image targets are static captures/diagrams; GIF targets are animated demonstrations. Both currently show the supplied neutral placeholder PNG.

slots.heading: The problem Link solves
slots.alt: Link Source and Target viewports within Unreal Engine's Level Editor
slots.caption: Link coordinates several Level Editor cameras while retaining an independent viewing position in each Target.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture Unreal's four-viewport layout with one Perspective Source and two visibly different Targets, with the Link toolbar controls and Source/Target selections legible.

slots.heading: Editor integration
slots.alt: Diagram of Link toolbar integration and camera synchronization
slots.caption: Link's Editor module connects the Level Editor viewport toolbar to in-memory role state and native viewport camera updates.
slots.capture_instructions: Create a diagram showing FLinkModule, LevelEditor.ViewportToolbar, the Source/Target key registry, the core ticker and Target viewport clients; distinguish UI and camera data.

slots.heading: Install from a packaged release
slots.alt: Correctly installed Link plugin folder inside a project
slots.caption: The Link plugin belongs directly under a project's Plugins directory, with its descriptor and resources available to Unreal Editor.
slots.capture_instructions: Show File Explorer at YourProject/Plugins/Link with Link.uplugin, Source, Resources and Config visible and the address bar showing the correct folder nesting.

slots.heading: Your first linked navigation
slots.alt: Two Level Editor viewports linking for the first time
slots.caption: Assigning a Perspective Source and a Target allows the Target camera to follow later movement without losing its chosen offset.
slots.capture_instructions: Record a 10–15-second Unreal Editor sequence with two viewports: select upper Source radio in Perspective 1, lower Target radio in Perspective 2, enable Link, then move Source and show Target following.

slots.heading: Where the controls live
slots.alt: Link's Sync, Link, Source, Target and Settings toolbar controls
slots.caption: All Link controls appear together in each Level Editor viewport toolbar near the native camera tools.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture a close-up of one viewport toolbar and label Sync, Link, upper Source selector, lower Target selector and Settings. Include enough of the viewport to establish location.

slots.heading: Entry construction
slots.alt: Diagram of the native Link toolbar entry construction
slots.caption: The Link toolbar is created through Unreal ToolMenus and uses the current Level Editor viewport context.
slots.capture_instructions: Create an annotated call-flow diagram from RegisterMenus to BuildToolbarEntries, showing LevelEditor.ViewportToolbar context, Sync/Link actions, role widget and Settings submenu.

slots.heading: Choose a Source
slots.alt: Perspective Source viewport with the upper Link role selected
slots.caption: The upper selector identifies the one viewport that drives the configured Targets.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture at least two viewports with the upper Source selector visibly active on Perspective 1 and inactive on Perspective 2. Keep both viewport labels visible.

slots.heading: Choose Targets
slots.alt: Assigning several Target viewports from individual toolbars
slots.caption: Link allows multiple Targets but keeps the Source and Target roles mutually exclusive.
slots.capture_instructions: Record a sequence assigning two Targets to one Source, selecting a new Source, and showing how the old Source selection is replaced; keep each viewport toolbar visible.

slots.heading: Example: preserve distance
slots.alt: Relative camera linking preserving an initial Target offset
slots.caption: Relative mode applies the Source's movement delta to Targets while keeping each Target's position and viewing offset.
slots.capture_instructions: Record two perspective viewports initially at distinct positions, enable Relative with X/Y/Z on, move the Source forward and sideways, and show Target following without snapping to Source.

slots.heading: Per-tick delta model
slots.alt: Diagram of Source camera delta applied to a Target camera
slots.caption: Relative movement adds Source translation and rotation deltas independently to each valid Target's enabled axes.
slots.capture_instructions: Create a concise diagram using example Source X 0→100 and Target X 500→600, plus separate yaw 0→30 and 90→120; mark these as independent axis calculations.

slots.heading: Example: preserve height
slots.alt: Absolute X/Y linking while retaining a different Target height
slots.caption: Absolute mode matches enabled Source coordinates while leaving disabled Target axes independent.
slots.capture_instructions: Record two perspectives with visibly different heights, show Settings X/Y on Z off in Absolute, then move Source horizontally and show Target matching X/Y while keeping its own Z.

slots.heading: Change-triggered absolute writes
slots.alt: Flow diagram showing how Absolute updates are triggered by Source changes
slots.caption: Absolute position and rotation are applied only after a corresponding Source movement is detected.
slots.capture_instructions: Diagram Source sample → position delta/rotation delta decisions → axis-mask checks → assign current Source values to Target; note mode/axis changes alone don't trigger immediate writes.

slots.heading: Align, then establish a new offset
slots.alt: One-Shot Sync aligning cameras before a Relative offset is set
slots.caption: Sync provides an immediate alignment, after which a Target can be repositioned for continued Relative linking.
slots.capture_instructions: Record two perspective viewports: click Sync to align enabled axes, manually move Target to a distinct view, then enable Relative Link and move Source to demonstrate the retained offset.

slots.heading: Open Link Settings
slots.alt: Complete Link Settings menu displaying axes, modes and Clear
slots.caption: The Settings menu provides independent X/Y/Z and Pitch/Yaw/Roll controls alongside Relative/Absolute mode and Clear.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture the full expanded Settings menu with Location X/Y/Z, Rotation Pitch/Yaw/Roll, Relative/Absolute selector and Clear, plus the toolbar anchor.

slots.heading: Native settings menu
slots.alt: Native Slate components used to construct Link's Settings menu
slots.caption: Link uses ToolMenus sections, segmented axis checkboxes and a Relative/Absolute selector to edit shared session state.
slots.capture_instructions: Create a compact diagram of Location, Rotation and Mode sections with their native Slate types and field names; emphasize that checking a box updates state rather than moving the camera immediately.

slots.heading: Set it up
slots.alt: Perspective Source guiding Top and Front orthographic views
slots.caption: Orthographic Targets follow selected Source position changes without rotating their fixed projections or changing zoom.
slots.capture_instructions: Record Perspective, Top and Front viewports together: show Source/Target roles, enable Relative X/Y/Z, navigate Perspective through the level and keep both orthographic camera views visible.

slots.heading: Projection checks
slots.alt: Diagram of Perspective Source eligibility and orthographic Target limitations
slots.caption: Link requires a Perspective Source, but orthographic Targets can still receive position updates.
slots.capture_instructions: Draw a capability diagram with Perspective Source → Perspective Target (position and rotation) and → Top/Front Target (position only), marking zoom and orthographic rotation as unsupported.

slots.heading: Maintain a side view while navigating
slots.alt: Multi-viewport navigation retaining a useful independent side perspective
slots.caption: A second Perspective camera can follow the Source's translation while maintaining its original viewing direction.
slots.capture_instructions: Record a main Perspective viewport moving down a corridor while a side-angle Perspective Target follows at its initial offset; keep the complete layout visible.

slots.heading: Keep Top and Front reference views with you
slots.alt: Multi-viewport layout with a Perspective Source and two orthographic references
slots.caption: Perspective, Top and Front viewports can track the same working area while showing different projections.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture a three- or four-viewport layout with Source and both Targets labeled, framing the same area in Perspective, Top and Front with visibly different zoom/orientation.

slots.heading: Native camera locks come first
slots.alt: Locked viewport excluded from Link Target synchronization
slots.caption: A camera-locked Target is skipped while other unlocked Targets can continue receiving Source movement.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture one Perspective Source, one Target visibly locked to an Actor/cinematic camera, and a second unlocked Target, with Lock indicators and role selectors clearly identifiable.

slots.heading: Play In Editor
slots.alt: Link pausing synchronization during Play In Editor
slots.caption: Link suspends when PIE begins and resumes future editor navigation from a fresh Source sample.
slots.capture_instructions: Record a viewport layout with Link enabled, enter PIE, move the game camera without the editor Target being driven, then exit PIE and demonstrate normal Source following resuming.

slots.heading: Clear returns to defaults
slots.alt: Link Settings Clear restoring the default Source, Target and axis configuration
slots.caption: Clear removes Link's session roles and restores default settings without moving existing cameras.
slots.capture_instructions: Record a linked setup with altered axes and Absolute mode, open Settings → Clear, then show Link off, no Source/Targets, X/Y/Z on, rotation off and Relative selected, with cameras stationary.

slots.heading: Native toolbar extension
slots.alt: Architecture of the Link ToolMenus and Slate viewport integration
slots.caption: Link registers native ToolMenus entries and tracks viewport widgets by configuration identity.
slots.capture_instructions: Create a labeled diagram showing RegisterMenus → BuildToolbarEntries → SLevelViewport/GetConfigKey → RegisteredViewports; include Source and Target key collections and native Slate icon/style registration.

slots.heading: Tick and early-outs
slots.alt: Camera synchronization loop with eligibility and baseline checks
slots.caption: Link updates eligible Target cameras only after Source movement is detected and all required editor guards pass.
slots.capture_instructions: Draw a flowchart: Tick → Link enabled, PIE, Perspective Source, locks → baseline present → delta checks → per-Target eligibility → Relative/Absolute axis writes → Invalidate.

slots.heading: Modes and controls
slots.alt: Comparison of Relative and Absolute linking with the same initial camera offsets
slots.caption: Relative preserves a Target's offset while Absolute aligns the enabled coordinates after Source movement.
slots.capture_instructions: Use a side-by-side comparison with matching two-viewport framing and clear Relative/Absolute labels, showing Target offset preserved versus enabled-axis position matched.

slots.heading: Sync button is disabled
slots.alt: Link Sync disabled because Source/Target prerequisites are not met
slots.caption: The Sync control requires a valid Perspective Source, at least one Target and an eligible editor state.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture a viewport toolbar where Sync is disabled, alongside a clearly identifiable missing Source or Target role; provide an adjacent corrected state showing Sync available.

slots.heading: Installing a newer precompiled release
slots.alt: Link plugin correctly installed in a project's Plugins folder
slots.caption: A complete compatible plugin folder replaces the previous Link installation when the Unreal Editor is closed.
slots.capture_instructions: Show the YourProject/Plugins/Link directory with Link.uplugin and Resources/Source contents visible; include a release version label if supplied by the package.

slots.heading: Shipped — v1.0.0
slots.alt: Link v1.0.0 feature overview showing synchronized editor viewports
slots.caption: Link's first release provides Relative, Absolute and one-shot Sync workflows through native Unreal viewport toolbar controls.
slots.capture_instructions: Create a clean static feature overview with a central Perspective Source linked to several Targets and labels for Relative, Absolute, Sync, axis filters and orthographic support. Do not depict unapproved future features.
